summary: Masonglory Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a share swap agreement on August 12, 2026, to acquire a 20% equity interest in Austria-based Beta Beteiligungs und Besitz GmbH from its 49% holder. Consideration is 1,377,000 Class A ordinary shares, priced at $3.40 per share based on the August 11 closing bid of $3.43, implying a $23.4 million valuation of the target. The target distributes construction materials in Continental Europe. Consideration shares are restricted securities issued offshore without registration. Post-close, the seller holds under 5% voting power. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing conditions; the share-swap structure avoids cash outlay.
